title: 3067. Count Pairs of Connectable Servers in a Weighted Tree Network

examples.explanation: Since signalSpeed is 1, count[c] is equal to the number of pairs of paths that start at c and do not share any edges. In the case of the given path graph, count[c] is equal to the number of servers to the left of c multiplied by the servers to the right of c.

Through server 0, there are 2 pairs of connectable servers: (4, 5) and (4, 6). Through server 6, there are 2 pairs of connectable servers: (4, 5) and (0, 5). It can be shown that no two servers are connectable through servers other than 0 and 6.
